title: Incremental Forensic Snapshots: Differential Compliance Exporter with Scheduled Delivery
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Deliver a tenant-aware compliance export pipeline that generates compact, incremental forensic snapshots (PDF and CSV) on a configurable cadence. The exporter must support differential snapshots (delta-only bundles since last successful snapshot), configurable redaction policies, region-aware delivery endpoints (S3, SFTP, pre-signed URL), cryptographic attestation (manifest signing), and an operations dashboard to monitor scheduled jobs, success/failure rates, sizes, and retention enforcement. This reduces nightly export cost and improves auditability for customers who require periodic evidence packages tied to residency and retention policies.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create a scheduled export job in Console with cadence (daily/weekly/monthly) and choose PDF, CSV, or both
Export job supports 'full' or 'incremental' mode; incremental captures only records changed since last successful export and produces a delta.csv plus an index.json manifest
Exports respect tenant data residency and route delivery to the region-specific storage endpoint; delivery failures trigger region-fallback per routing policy
Redaction rules can be attached to a job (regex fields, PII categories) and are applied before packaging; audit log captures redaction decisions
Every export bundle includes a signed manifest (SHA256+timestamp) and optional customer-facing attestation PDF that lists included records and redaction summary
Retention lifecycle is enforced: scheduled exports older than configured retention are purged from the export store and recorded in the retention ledger
Console shows per-job telemetry: last-run, last-success, artifact-size, number-of-records, and estimated cost; alerts for repeated failures (3x) escalate to oncall
End-to-end tests (integration) and a migration path for existing ad-hoc exports are available before GA
notes: We intentionally produce a combined PDF+CSV workflow: CSV for machine audits and diffs, PDF for human-readable attestations. Differential strategy uses changefeeds where available and falls back to snapshot scanning with watermarking. UX should surface conflict cases where a tenant's retention policy would remove a record referenced in the export; in those cases we include a redaction placeholder and log the reason.
